page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor. This x86_64 architecture system features 8 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 60.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.5 GB per core. For hardware acceleration, the instance includes a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a bundled 472 GB SSD, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates highly specialized performance characteristics. General CPU and memory operations show limitations, with stress-ng single-core performance in the bottom 10% and multi-core performance in the bottom 25%. Similarly, memory read bandwidth and database operations score in the bottom 25%. However, the integrated NVIDIA P100 GPU delivers strong results for specific workloads. Large language model inference benchmarks show top-tier performance in the top 10% for prompt processing on both 135M and 7B models, as well as top-tier text generation speeds on 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance represents an older hardware generation that trades raw CPU compute efficiency for dedicated GPU acceleration and bundled local SSD storage. It is not optimal for CPU-bound tasks, database operations, or high-throughput memory-bound workloads due to its lower benchmark scores in those areas. Instead, the ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is best suited for GPU-accelerated workloads such as small to medium-sized LLM inference, legacy machine learning model training, and parallel processing tasks that can leverage the Pascal architecture.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance featuring an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor with 8 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 60.0 GB of RAM, a bundled 472 GB local SSD, and a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. While general CPU and memory benchmarks fall into the lower percentiles, the instance excels in GPU-driven tasks. Specifically, it achieves top-tier performance in prompt processing and text generation for small to medium-sized large language models. This hardware profile makes the instance a qualitatively cost-effective choice for legacy GPU workloads, machine learning inference, and parallel computing tasks rather than general-purpose database or CPU-heavy applications.
